power_source: unverified; board has a physical power switch
observations: The FT232R session opened, settled for approximately 0.2 seconds, drained no startup bytes, and closed normally.
The Replica display became garbage during the session.
Physical Reset restored a stable monitor prompt and flashing @ cursor.
conclusion: Confirmed: opening the FT232R through the host serial stack is sufficient to disturb the board. Unverified: the electrical mechanism; no scope or logic-analyzer trace was captured.
recovery: Use the physical Reset button; do not use Clear or repeat a serial open until board-path measurement is available.
